policy: same pitcher until current half end; generic paired 2023-end league future batters; neutral subsequent-game policy
uncertainty: MC95 and descriptive central80 bootstrap classifier band; fixed transition/WE/RE and no hidden-confounding correction
scope: 2024 stratified research cases, not league aggregate effects; no operational recommendation or long-term resource cost

protocol.model: frozen Slice12 matchup alpha=.001 pooling=20; Slice13 signal trajectories are not projected
protocol.arms: current pitcher through half end vs uniformly selected nominal previously-observed RP through half end; no later substitution
protocol.legality: Slice11 both-actions nominal legal boundary; pitcher stays to inning end, satisfying three-batter minimum/inning-end exception; injury/medical/warmup availability unknown
protocol.pool_support: zero-ball/strike nominal legal boundary; known past RP role, >=30 own-all PA, known L/R hand, complete 14d lookback and known rest; at least two candidates; current >=30 own-all and known hand
protocol.future_batters: actual next batter only at first PA; later batters paired from frozen 2023-end league pool with hand-specific past rates, not future actual lineup
protocol.workload: increment game/rolling pitches using training-only target/role pitch-count distribution; BF +1; entry rest/history fixed; is_current true after first PA
protocol.transitions: training-only joint conditional tables, legal runner conservation, walk-off non-HR winning-run cap and terminal WE rules
protocol.endpoint: current half-inning end or walk-off; same policy in both arms; beyond-half strategy neutral WE reference; xRE24=start RE-total runs
protocol.uncertainty: paired Monte Carlo 95% normal-error interval, plus descriptive central80% across 8 game-cluster classifier refits with fixed preprocessing/transition/WE/RE; not complete uncertainty or a causal CI
protocol.limits: censored tails or model pitch-count extrapolation block supported preference; no long-term bullpen resource cost, exact future lineup, signal progression, causal policy value or individual ranking
protocol.test_policy: no 2025/2026 outcome metrics; no test-based selection
